   "source": [
    "# This cell is removed with the tag: \"remove-input\"\n",
    "# As such, it will not be shown in documentation\n",
    "\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d6bc2725",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Cookbook_Trajectory_Performance_Analysis)=\n",
    "# Trajectory Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "*Calculating RMSD, RMSF, and radius of gyration time series across trajectory structures.*\n",
    "\n",
    "Analyzing structural stability and conformational dynamics across thousands of trajectory frames requires high-performance analytical routines. MolSysMT provides vector-accelerated and multi-threaded analytical functions for core metrics like RMSD, RMSF, and Radius of Gyration.\n",
    "\n",
    "In this recipe, we analyze a solvated Villin Headpiece trajectory, compute structural observables, and generate a stability summary plot.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "36078050",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Loading Trajectory\n",
    "\n",
    "We load the topology and trajectory files for the Villin Headpiece (HP35) and configure multi-threading:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "8049fa50",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:35:54.667318Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:35:54.666892Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:02.270921Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:02.269684Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "WARNING: Structural attributes were dropped because only an item outside the structure axis of the molecular system provides them: atom_index, structure_chemical_state_index, structure_id, time. (Hint: A file holding a single reference conformation cannot supply a series for a whole trajectory. Take the attribute from the trajectory item, or convert first. Docs: https://www.uibcdf.org/MolSysMT)\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Loaded 20 structures with 4369 atoms.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# Load solvated trajectory\n",
    "topology = msm.systems['chicken villin HP35']['chicken_villin_HP35_solvated.h5msm']\n",
    "trajectory = msm.systems['chicken villin HP35']['traj_chicken_villin_HP35_solvated.dcd']\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert([topology, trajectory], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Configure parallel execution\n",
    "msm.configure.set_parallelization(parallel='auto', num_threads=4)\n",
    "print(f\"Loaded {msm.get(molsys, n_structures=True)} structures with {msm.get(molsys, n_atoms=True)} atoms.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c15af7b3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Calculating RMSD\n",
    "\n",
    "We calculate the C-alpha and backbone RMSD time series relative to the initial structure (frame 0):"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "3707c6f0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:02.278301Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:02.277555Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.387103Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.385638Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "C-alpha RMSD: mean = 3.168 nanometer nm, max = 4.166 nanometer nm\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compute C-alpha RMSD\n",
    "rmsd_ca = msm.structure.get_rmsd(\n",
    "    molsys,\n",
    "    selection='atom_name==\"CA\"',\n",
    "    reference_structure_index=0\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Compute all heavy-atom backbone RMSD\n",
    "rmsd_bb = msm.structure.get_rmsd(\n",
    "    molsys,\n",
    "    selection='backbone',\n",
    "    reference_structure_index=0\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"C-alpha RMSD: mean = {np.mean(rmsd_ca):.3f} nm, max = {np.max(rmsd_ca):.3f} nm\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4f80216e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Calculating RMSF\n",
    "\n",
    "We compute per-residue fluctuations to identify flexible loops versus stable secondary structure elements:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "28a134da",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.390597Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.390198Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.878561Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.877809Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "RMSF calculated for 36 residues.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compute C-alpha RMSF per residue\n",
    "rmsf_ca = msm.structure.get_rmsf(\n",
    "    molsys,\n",
    "    selection='atom_name==\"CA\"'\n",
    ")\n",
    "residue_indices = np.arange(len(rmsf_ca))\n",
    "print(f\"RMSF calculated for {len(rmsf_ca)} residues.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cfd7bcbf",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Calculating Radius of Gyration\n",
    "\n",
    "We compute the compactness of the protein across the trajectory using {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_radius_of_gyration`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "8f922f63",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.882370Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:03.882083Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:04.296815Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:04.291486Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Radius of Gyration: mean = 0.944 nanometer nm\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compute protein radius of gyration\n",
    "rg = msm.structure.get_radius_of_gyration(\n",
    "    molsys,\n",
    "    selection='group_type==\"amino acid\"'\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(f\"Radius of Gyration: mean = {np.mean(rg):.3f} nm\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b30a16d2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plotting Structural Observables\n",
    "\n",
    "We summarize the structural observables in a 3-panel figure:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "2e6dd7b6",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:04.300209Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:04.299875Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:05.161893Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:05.160618Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1500x400 with 3 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4))\n",
    "frames = np.arange(len(rmsd_ca))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Panel 1: RMSD Time Series\n",
    "axes[0].plot(frames, msm.pyunitwizard.get_value(rmsd_ca, to_unit='nm'), label='C-alpha', color='#2980B9')\n",
    "axes[0].plot(frames, msm.pyunitwizard.get_value(rmsd_bb, to_unit='nm'), label='Backbone', color='#E74C3C', linestyle='--')\n",
    "axes[0].set_xlabel('Frame index')\n",
    "axes[0].set_ylabel('RMSD (nm)')\n",
    "axes[0].set_title('Structural Stability')\n",
    "axes[0].legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Panel 2: RMSF Fluctuation Profile\n",
    "axes[1].bar(residue_indices, msm.pyunitwizard.get_value(rmsf_ca, to_unit='nm'), color='#27AE60')\n",
    "axes[1].set_xlabel('Residue Index')\n",
    "axes[1].set_ylabel('RMSF (nm)')\n",
    "axes[1].set_title('Residue Flexibility')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Panel 3: Radius of Gyration\n",
    "axes[2].plot(frames, msm.pyunitwizard.get_value(rg, to_unit='nm'), color='#8E44AD')\n",
    "axes[2].set_xlabel('Frame index')\n",
    "axes[2].set_ylabel('Radius of Gyration (nm)')\n",
    "axes[2].set_title('Protein Compactness')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
